Refactor dashboards and navbars for role separation

Introduces separate dashboard and navbar components for bounty hunters and bounty posters, replacing the generic DashboardNavbar with BountyHunterNavbar and BountyPosterNavbar. Updates dashboard pages to use role-specific dashboards and navigation, and cleans up related imports and logic. Adds new utility and component files to support these changes.
